# Alloha Qi Space

> Zhineng Qigong classes and Hun Yuan Qi therapy with certified teacher Rikhil Bithar, at Unit 1, Kalpataru Regency 2, Lane 10, Kalyani Nagar, Pune 411006, India, and online worldwide. Beginner-friendly; no experience needed. Sessions complement, and never replace, medical care.

## Key facts
- Teacher: Rikhil Bithar, who founded Alloha Qi Space with his mother, Ravina Bithar
- Practices: Zhineng Qigong (gentle movement, relaxed breathing, calm attention) and Hun Yuan Qi therapy sessions
- Formats: in person at the Pune centre, live online classes and sessions, corporate wellness programs, healing events, online courses
- Hours: Mon–Sat, 8 am–8 pm (Sunday closed)
- Booking: WhatsApp or call +91 98811 92288, or the booking form at https://www.allohaqispace.com/contact-us/
- Fees: shared on request on WhatsApp
- Payments: UPI, cards and cash

## Programs
- [Foundational Qigong Practice](https://www.allohaqispace.com/foundational-qigong-practice/): The “Hold Qi Up, Pour Qi Down” method, the heart of Zhineng Qigong and the perfect place to start.
- [Neck Health Care](https://www.allohaqispace.com/neck-health-care/): A precise six-step Zhineng Qigong sequence to release tension, restore mobility and support posture.
- [Eye Recovery & Brain Cells](https://www.allohaqispace.com/eye-recovery/): Qigong practices to ease eye strain and nourish the eyes and brain with fresh Qi.
- [Restructuring with Zhineng Qi Gong](https://www.allohaqispace.com/restructuring-with-zhineng-qi-gong/): Connect with Hun Yuan Qi to restructure, heal and rejuvenate the body from within.
- [Qi Core Improvement – Revitalize the Spine](https://www.allohaqispace.com/qi-core-improvement/): A six-form system by Master Yuantong Liu, based on Dr. Pang’s methods, for the spine, organs and brain.
- [Physical and Mental Restoration](https://www.allohaqispace.com/physical-and-mental-restoration/): Use conscious awareness to repair the body, gather a scattered mind, and restore harmony.
- [Special Care for Delicate Situations](https://www.allohaqispace.com/special-care-for-delicate-situations/): Gentle, adapted support during pregnancy, illness, recovery and other sensitive times.
- [Comprehensive Consultations](https://www.allohaqispace.com/comprehensive-consultations/): A deep look at your food, environment and hidden risks, ending with a personal blueprint for well-being.
- [Online Healing & Classes](https://www.allohaqispace.com/online-healing-classes/): Live online classes, Hun Yuan Qi healing sessions and consultations, wherever you are in the world.

## Guides from the journal
- [What Is Qigong? A Beginner's Guide to Qigong Classes in Pune](https://www.allohaqispace.com/blog/what-is-qigong-beginners-guide-pune/): New to qigong? Learn what it is, how it works, its benefits and what a beginner class in Pune looks like. Start your practice with Alloha Qi Space.
- [Qigong vs Yoga: Which Practice Is Right for You?](https://www.allohaqispace.com/blog/qigong-vs-yoga/): Qigong or yoga? Compare movement, breathing, intensity and benefits to choose the right mind-body practice for you. A clear guide for India.
- [Qigong for Stress Relief: 5 Simple Practices for Busy Pune Professionals](https://www.allohaqispace.com/blog/qigong-for-stress-relief-pune-professionals/): Long hours in Hinjewadi or Kharadi? Try these 5 simple qigong practices for stress relief that take under 10 minutes and need no equipment.
